details:
I have a couple of feature suggestions that I think could make VRChat’s loading and social features a lot more convenient:

1. Avatar preloading

Similar to how it would be nice to preload a world before actually switching into it, I think it would be really useful to have the ability to preload an avatar before switching to it.

For example, if I select an avatar that I want to switch to, VRChat could download and load the avatar in the background first, and then actually switch to it once it’s ready. That way I wouldn’t have to spend several seconds appearing as a blue diamond  while the actual avatar loads.

Ideally, this could also work in a way that lets other people preload the avatar ahead of time, if technically possible. For example, if I change into an avatar but it hasn't finished loading for someone else yet, they could click on me and have an option such as Preload Avatar. While that avatar is downloading and loading, they could continue seeing the avatar I was previously wearing rather than seeing me as a blue diamond. Once the new avatar finishes loading, they could receive a notification that it's ready and then see the new avatar normally.

This could work somewhat similarly to how avatar previews work when trying on avatars. If I'm trying on an avatar in the avatar shop, other people don't see me suddenly switch into that trial avatar while it's loading. They continue seeing the avatar I was already wearing. I think a similar system could work for avatar preloading, where someone's client prepares the new avatar in the background while continuing to display the previous avatar until the new one is ready.

That way, people could choose whether they want to preload someone's avatar, rather than VRChat automatically forcing everyone nearby to download it. It would also give users more control over their bandwidth and avatar loading.

Feature Recommendation 2:

Direct messaging with message history

VRChat has been adding more social features that make it feel increasingly like a social platform, such as mutual friends and mutual groups. One feature I think would fit really well with that direction is a proper direct messaging system.

I don’t mean the existing in-world Chatbox. I mean something more like a Discord or Rec Room-style DM system where you can select a friend, send them text messages outside of a world, and have a conversation history that you can return to later.

Rec Room used to have something similar, where you could message someone directly and have a history of your conversation with them. I think something like that would be especially useful in VRChat for things like making plans, sending someone a message when they’re offline, following up with someone you met in a world, or simply having a conversation without needing to be in the same instance.

With VRChat becoming more socially connected through friends, groups, invites, and other features, I think persistent DMs would be a really natural addition.

Just wanted to throw these ideas out there. I’d personally love to see both of these features eventually!
title: Social & Performance Improvements.
